stole.description: Two ivory hanging panels, broad near shoulder, narrow at waist, widening toward embroidered ends; teal cowl crosses above.
stole.folds: Left shoulder diagonal to waist at (235,250), left vertical fall to (237,379); right fall (286,161) to (299,357), narrow dark fold on inner edge.
stole.endpoint_choice: idle/01 panel shapes and motif spacing; swing/05 confirms construction but right sprig/fringe sits ~7px higher.

embroidery.description: One muted grey-green botanical sprig on EACH ivory panel (2 total); single central stem, alternating oblique leaf strokes; pale ochre short bottom border. No repeated floral diamonds.
embroidery.count_uncertainty: ~1 branch at 512px: left upper stem obscured by mace; do not reconstruct hidden pattern.
embroidery.source_rule: Use anchor crop pixels, not newly invented leaves. Left partial occlusion remains legitimate.

tassels.description: Short irregular pale fringe strands at each stole end, plus ONE long knotted waist cord end; fringe is not the waist cord.
tassels.rule: Preserve sampled anchor edge, including uneven tips; no uniform extra 20px fringe.

mace.canon: APPROVED short one-handed flanged mace; no canon edit.
mace.shape: Angular dark iron flanged star head with projecting triangular fins, worn oak haft, small brass collar before head; rounded pommel.
mace.projection_limit: Lengths are anchor projections, not a 3D length. Preserve each A6 pose weapon/grip geometry where projected length differs; no global length invention.

feet.description: Two worn brown rounded ankle boots, dark seams and laces; both visibly join legs under inner robe.
feet.pivot_note: [256,464] is the unchanged actor registration origin, NOT the centre of each shoe; two feet cannot both occupy one pivot.

limits: Manual visible landmarks +/-2px, hidden joints +/-12px. Masks are permission ceilings, not anatomical acceptance. Exact anchor pixels take precedence. No Owner art approval.
